_comment: Recorded, checked-in baseline for scripts/validate_all.py to regression-test against. Recorded 2026-09-12 by actually running each harness (ml/eval_zscore_baseline.py, ml/benchmark_model.py, ml/symbiosis_model.py) — not copied from earlier session notes. That mattered: this run found the numbers had already quietly drifted from the figures documented in ml/LIMITATIONS.md (recorded when the anomaly-detector/benchmark-model fixes first landed, before later generator changes shifted the ground-truth data slightly) — z-score precision/recall moved from the documented 0.57/0.92 to 0.553/0.913, and the benchmark model's improvement moved from 36.9%/6.3% to 38.3%/12.9%. Both are still well within healthy ranges, but this drift going undetected until now is exactly why this file exists. If you regenerate the synthetic dataset or retrain a model, re-run scripts/validate_all.py --update-baseline to intentionally accept new numbers — never hand-edit this file to make a failing check pass.

zscore_anomaly_detector.description: backend/app/intelligence/anomaly.py — the anomaly detector actually in production.
zscore_anomaly_detector.note: Tolerance band, not an exact-match requirement: small ground-truth-label drift from re-running the synthetic generator is expected and fine; a drop below these floors means a real regression (e.g. someone loosened the thresholds) and should block a ship.

benchmark_model.description: ml/benchmark_model.py (LightGBM) vs. the flat sourced benchmark.
benchmark_model.note: min_leave_one_cluster_out_improvement_pct=0.0 means: must not be WORSE than the flat benchmark for a brand-new cluster (that was the original bug this model found and fixed at the data-generator level — see data-pipeline/LIMITATIONS.md #9). Going negative again would mean that fix broke.

symbiosis_matcher.note: min_semantic_similarity_threshold must stay >= the value that excluded the textile_sludge/cotton_waste false-positive match found during Phase 3c (see ml/LIMITATIONS.md) — lowering it silently would reintroduce that exact bug.

anomaly_autoencoder.description: ml/anomaly_model.py (PyTorch) — built, evaluated, intentionally NOT in production.
anomaly_autoencoder.note: This is a sanity check, not a quality bar: if a future retrain suddenly reports 'beats_baseline', that's worth a deliberate human decision to promote it to production — not something that should happen silently via an automated pipeline. Flagged, not failed.
